title: Analysing Mental Health Issues Faced by Students
what_it_is: Analysing Mental Health Issues Faced by Students

sections.label: Youth mental health research and measures
sections.summary: MOE uses two research studies and collaborates with MOH and MSF to improve student mental health measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Two of the latest research studies are the 2020 Youth Epidemiology and Resilience Study with the National University of Singapore and the 2024 National Youth Mental Health Study by the Institute of Mental Health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These research insights and data are used to improve the full suite of measures on student mental health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, we regularly refresh the Mental Health Education lessons within the Character and Citizenship Education Curriculum to address emerging issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE also collaborates with other Government agencies, such as the Ministry of Health (MOH) as well as the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF), to implement the National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This includes the Tiered Care Model for youths to promote help-seeking and improve their access to services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Parenting for Wellness initiative was also launched to equip parents with practical skills in strengthening parent-child relationships and their children's resilience.

sections.label: National youth suicide rate data
sections.summary: The speaker does not have data specific to national suicide rates for youths aged 10 to 29.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Specific to the question on national suicide rates with regards to the youth population between 10 and 29 years old, I do not have the data specific to this particular question.

sections.label: School counsellors and REACH teams
sections.summary: School counsellors conduct suicide risk assessments and work with MOH, REACH teams and hospital specialist teams.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: At the school level, we have our school counsellors who can do a suicide risk assessment and also work in tandem with our colleagues from MOH as well as healthcare institutions, in terms of the Response, Early intervention and Assessment in Community mental Health (REACH) teams, which also work very closely with our schools, as well as the specialist teams which reside in the hospitals.
